$Comment: The third rung of Orrin's Vow: what the Outlanders carry. The cult's warriors drop the Doomed
weapons they fight with, and this rung sends the player to take some and bring them to the
cull_outlanders is KILL_ENTITY on 'Outlander' with CONTAINS, so every Outlander role counts
(peon, cultist, hunter, priest and the rest); unmake_doomed counts Doomed gear the tables took
apart ('_Doomed' on CONTAINS, which catches every Doomed weapon whatever its family, qualified
to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count, with its own TextKey because the kind's
default line would print the bare match string). Both sit on Order 1, so the hunt and the
sitting run side by side. The Doomed weapons also drop from the Outlander camps' chests, so a
player who would rather not fight for them can loot them instead.
Rewards sit in Claim: Enchanting XP and a personal Enchanting boost token. The Chains entry
files it as tier 3 of orrins_vow. Retune the kill count to make the hunt longer or shorter.
Name: Outlander_Steel
